segments.comment: Variation of item-actions-no-entry-key-independent: a stack of eucalyptus leaves (quan > 1) is looked up through singular(otmp, xname) as "eucalyptus leaf", which pager.c ia_checkfile() does not find in data.base, so iactions.c itemactions() offers no '/' choice.
